executionMode: single-agent; implementation approved; no live deployment
amendments: Cleanup retention configurable per resource type; defaults 7/7/30 days; never and global automatic-off supported.

tasks.subject: Managed foundation and Devkit credentials
tasks.description:
**Goal:** persistent OpenBao is ready before credentials are collected; native UI works over private HTTPS and secrets survive restart/recovery.

**Create:** `cmd/devkit/vault.go` (managed lifecycle/config/setup), `vault_client.go` (HTTP/KV), `vault_backup.go` (scheduled encrypted backup), `integrations.go` (references/runtime delivery), `git_credentials.go` (accepted Git HTTPS/GitHub support), matching `_test.go` files; `tests/openbao_runtime_acceptance.py`.

**Modify:** `cmd/devkit/main.go`, `setup.go`, `hostconfig.go`, `proxy.go`, `share.go`, `auth.go`, `server.go`, `doctor.go`, `git_control.go` only for credential delivery; `bootstrap.sh`, `bundle.sh`, `docs/setup.md`, `docs/shares.md`. Keep Go standard-library-only.

- [ ] Pin/test a stable OpenBao image and persistent non-dev single-node Raft configuration. Start at 512 MiB limit, soft 0.5 CPU budget and monitored 1–2 GiB data estimate. Preserve existing volumes on reinstall/restart; refuse ambiguous initialization. Keep audit/storage private and protect swap/core dumps.
- [ ] Implement resumable provider setup, ready/sealed/unavailable health and manual human init/unseal without ordinary stdout/jobs/transcripts containing recovery material. Establish one least-privilege backend identity; keep native human admin separate and retire root after verification. Local recovery must not depend on web session signing, Cloudflare or Traefik.
- [ ] Add OpenBao references for Cloudflare DNS/share credentials, web-session signing and explicitly configured integration secrets. Collect only after readiness; preserve unrelated config. Verified import previews sources, compares private readback and tests consumers before switching references; remove only exact unchanged originals after confirmation. Never execute legacy command sources during discovery.
- [ ] Replace persisted DNS/tunnel environment values with private memory-backed file delivery supported by pinned images. Keep local ACME volume as sole Traefik-owned state, restrictive permissions and encrypted backup. Add exact vault TLS/private route and direct LAN split DNS checks. Test cold proxy start with a sealed vault separately from issuance/renewal; report limitations without a cached plaintext token fallback.
- [ ] Provide scheduled encrypted backups of Raft, registry/cleanup state when present, non-secret manifest and local ACME state. Use established encryption tooling, human-held recovery keys and a configured off-host destination; no bespoke crypto or administrative dashboard. Consistent ACME capture may briefly stop Traefik; disclose it and restart on failure. Restore procedure verifies an isolated restore and preserves IDs/permissions; snapshot alone is not a complete host backup. Never bundle unseal/decryption keys.
- [ ] Retain accepted generic Git HTTPS and GitHub token support: explicit repository binding to Git's helper protocol, exact host/port/path matching, project ownership checks and no fallback to stale helpers for vault-bound remotes. Keep unrelated/global helpers and SSH unchanged; no tokens in Git URLs/config/argv. GitHub API validation reports actual access; no GitLab-specific adapter, Git lifecycle expansion or Tailscale API automation. Project use cannot silently receive an operator integration token. Finish project-context binding with Milestone 2.

**Verify:** focused `go test ./cmd/devkit -run 'TestVault|TestIntegration|TestGitCredentials|TestSetup|TestProxy|TestShare|TestWebPassword|TestSession'`; `python3 tests/bootstrap_acceptance.py`; disposable runtime profiles for fresh/repeated setup, opt-out, sealed/reboot, migration interruption, token delivery, backup/restore and generic non-GitHub HTTPS/GitHub fixtures. Scan controlled sentinels in generated config, Docker inspect and logs. Probe actual LAN and remote Tailscale DNS/TLS/native login; mark unavailable external probes pending.

**Acceptance:** no reinitialization/data loss, no routine root credentials, no plaintext persisted consumer tokens, no sealed-vault fallback; manual recovery works independently; stored settings and certificate state restore successfully. Opt-out preserves existing local settings and clearly disables managed project-secret functionality.

tasks.subject: Save, find and use contextual secrets
tasks.description:
**Goal:** an agent saves a credential through CLI; the human finds/reveals/copies it in the right project view, with correct inheritance and configurable recoverable cleanup.

**Create:** `cmd/devkit/secrets.go`, `secret_registry.go`, `secret_cleanup.go`, corresponding `_test.go` files; `frontend/src/components/ProjectSecrets.vue`, `frontend/src/views/SecretsSettingsView.vue`, `frontend/src/secrets.ts`; `frontend/tests/secrets.test.ts`, `frontend/tests/secrets.spec.ts`.

**Modify:** `cmd/devkit/main.go`, `server.go`, `actions.go`, `projects.go`, `repo.go`, `vault_backup.go`; `frontend/src/App.vue`, `main.ts`, `dashboard.ts`, `types.ts`, `frontend/src/views/ProjectDetailView.vue`; `web/dist/` via build; `README.md`, `docs/projects.md`, `docs/dashboard.md`.

- [ ] Build the private registry, explicit enrollment/reconciliation and shared scope/KV operation layer. Implement all contextual CLI commands and immutable ownership checks. Keep existing preview IDs and Git behavior. Implement minimal authenticated-actor audit metadata without values or treating `DEVKIT_BY` as authentication.
- [ ] Add private CLI transport and authenticated web adapters; never expose secret metadata through anonymous inventories. Reveal/copy uses transient responses, not retained jobs. Validate request ownership and prevent project operations addressing system/integration paths. Keep backend credentials out of children, project files and protocol responses.
- [ ] Add a reusable Secrets panel for project, branch and selected worktree; include branches without worktrees. Show own/inherited/effective source and last update, explicit scope for edits, generate/set/reveal/copy/update/rotate/history/restore. Settings supplies provider health/native UI link, integration controls and cleanup settings. No full OpenBao admin replica.
- [ ] Implement confirmed secret retirement, soft deletion/restoration, scheduled retry/destruction and manual purge from the shared cleanup contract. Persist config/deadlines and pending operations. No automatic registration/deletion from discovery or preview gc; do not shorten protection through branch/worktree disappearance or project cascade.
- [ ] Ensure secrets leave frontend memory on hide/navigation/logout/KeepAlive deactivation; cancel stale requests so old values cannot reappear. No browser storage or analytics values. Complete repository credential bindings with registered project identities and preserve normal agent/Git workflows.

**Verify:** `go test ./cmd/devkit -run 'TestSecrets|TestSecretRegistry|TestSecretCleanup|TestGitCredentials|TestProject|TestGitControl'`; focused race checks for registry/cleanup; `pnpm --dir frontend test`, `pnpm --dir frontend test:ui`, `pnpm --dir frontend build`. Extend disposable runtime tests for actual KV version deletion/restoration/destruction, API denial and restart during cleanup.

**Acceptance:** end-to-end CLI generate/set → UI metadata → explicit reveal/copy shows the same value; list/history never expose values. Test all three precedence levels, parent-write protection, CAS conflict, detached/reused/moved checkouts, external Git changes and no changes to source/Git from cleanup. Virtual-clock tests cover default 7/7/30, custom durations, `never`, global off, restart while off, settings changes, overdue re-enable confirmation, parent cascade, restore/purge races and every retained KV version. UI/CLI parity includes cleanup configuration and manual purge.

tasks.subject: Agent discovery, documentation and release checks
tasks.description:
**Goal:** fresh Codex and Claude sessions use the save/find/inject workflow without a reminder, and the feature ships with a tested recovery path.

**Create:** `agent-assets/embed.go`, `agent-assets/devkit-secrets/SKILL.md`, `agent-assets/AGENTS.md.fragment`, `agent-assets/CLAUDE.md.fragment`, `agent-assets/manifest.json`; `cmd/devkit/agent_integrations.go`, `agent_integrations_test.go`; `tests/agent_secrets_acceptance.py`; `docs/secrets.md` (user guide).

**Modify:** `cmd/devkit/setup.go`, `doctor.go`, `project_create.go`, `main.go`; `project-template/AGENTS.md`, `project-template/CLAUDE.md`; `frontend/src/views/SecretsSettingsView.vue`; `bundle.sh`, `.github/workflows/release.yml`, `.github/workflows/frontend.yml`; `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `docs/setup.md`, `docs/projects.md`, `docs/dashboard.md`, `docs/testing.md`. Leave historical planning inputs clearly labeled rather than rewrite them as shipped documentation.

- [ ] Embed/install one versioned skill into verified supported Codex/Claude directories in their existing account/home. Managed updates preserve local edits; provide install/status/repair and doctor CLI/UI parity. Merge bounded instruction blocks into projects without replacing user content; register/update existing worktrees explicitly, never by discovery side effect.
- [ ] Skill checks context and existing keys, chooses scope, saves/generates through CLI and reports the location/name rather than the value. Prefer injection; allow explicit reveal when required. Explain custom/disabled cleanup, fail-closed sealed behavior, and that stored-password rotation/deletion does not modify the consuming application.
- [ ] Verify fresh-session discovery for both agents and existing T3/SSH/Git/preview compatibility. Inspect real deployed permissions and report the trusted same-user limit; do not require OS isolation or redesign launchers.
- [ ] Finish user docs, scheduled-backup/restore instructions and upgrade/reinstall data-preservation checks. Use existing release/test runners, not a new orchestration framework. Include all assets in both release architectures.

**Verify:** `go test ./...`, `go vet ./...`, clean `gofmt -l .`; existing bootstrap and frontend checks; bundle amd64/arm64; opt-in disposable OpenBao and agent acceptance runners. Build test binaries into temporary locations, not the live `bin/devkit` target. Use synthetic credentials and no production service mutation during tests.

**Acceptance:** both fresh agents discover/use the skill, instructions survive repair with user edits intact, no generated password appears in routine logs/output, and supported CLI/UI operations are documented. Record any unavailable remote-client or installed-agent acceptance as pending, never simulated success.
